scienceData.startBluetooth: Start micro:bit Nordic UART. Select micro:bit in Bowerbird Web BLE; wait for connection before sending.
scienceData.bluetoothConnected: True once the web app has connected to the board.
scienceData.sendUSB: Send one sample as comma-separated numbers. Set Bowerbird to comma and 115200 baud. Empty or invalid samples are skipped.
scienceData.sendValueUSB: Put one sensor reading in this block. Bowerbird USB settings: 115200 baud, comma delimiter.
scienceData.sendBluetooth: Start Bluetooth once at program start. A disconnected sample is dropped. No headers or units are sent.
scienceData.sendValueBluetooth: Start Bluetooth at program start and connect Bowerbird in micro:bit mode. Put a single sensor reading in this block.
scienceWeather.sht31: i2c-002: GXHT30/SHT30/SHT31 at I2C 0x44. Shared single-shot command, CRC and conversion verified in GXHT30 datasheet sections 7.3/7.11/7.12. Failed temperature=-127, humidity=-1.
scienceWeather.bmp280: i2c-006: connect BMP280 to I2C. Altitude assumes 1013.25 hPa sea-level pressure. Failures: -127 °C, -1 hPa, -9999 m.
scienceWeather.infraredTemperature: i2c-003: connect MLX90614 to I2C. Do not combine with CCS811 at address 0x5A. Failed read or PEC returns -127 °C.
scienceMotion.mpu6050: i2c-007: I2C MPU6050, ±2 g / ±500 °/s. Same-address RTC cannot share the bus. Failure=-999.
scienceMotion.zeroGyro: Keep MPU6050 still for about one second. Only gyro zero is adjusted; gravity remains in acceleration.
scienceMotion.weight: i2c-010 MCU/HX711 module, I2C address 0x63; connect its load-cell plate. Raw module reading, unit must be verified. Failure=-1.
scienceMotion.joystick: a-028 joystick: connect the selected X or Y signal to a 3.3V analog pin. Returns 0..1023.
scienceDetection.color: i2c-012 TCS34725: I2C, raw light counts 0..65535. Do not share address 0x29 with VL53L0X. Failure=-1.
scienceDetection.ultrasonic: Two-signal ultrasonic only: connect separate TRIG and ECHO. A 3-pin single-signal module requires another protocol and is not supported here. Level-shift 5V ECHO. No echo=-1 cm.
scienceWeather.ntc: a-005: NTC 10kΩ/B3950, with 10kΩ lower resistor. Use 3.3V analog G/V/S. Module resistor orientation must match. Disconnected/rail reading=-127.
scienceWeather.calibratePT100: a-001 PT100 module: capture two known reference temperatures in the range of your experiment. Calibration resets when the program restarts.
scienceWeather.pt100: PT100 analog module: first calibrate at two known temperatures. Linear estimate only within those points; unavailable/out-of-range=-9999 °C.
scienceWater.calibratePH: pH analog module: immerse in pH 7 or pH 4 buffer, wait until stable, then capture. Calibration is kept until reset.
scienceWater.ph: a-009/010: 3.3V analog port. Calibrate with pH7 and pH4 buffers first. Failed/un-calibrated=-1; analog disconnection cannot be reliably detected.
scienceWater.tds: a-011/012, Gravity-compatible TDS module: 3.3V analog input. Estimated TDS ppm at measured water temperature; not electrical conductivity. Invalid=-1.
scienceElectric.zeroCurrent: a-032 WCS2801: power from 3.3V. Disconnect measured current before zeroing; zero calibration is lost on restart.
scienceElectric.calibrateCurrent: After zeroing, apply a known DC current measured by a reference meter. Sensitivity varies with supply voltage and module.
scienceElectric.current: WCS2801 1A module, 3.3V supply. Zero and calibrate with a known current first. Failure/outside ±1A=-9999.
scienceWeather.dht: d-001/002: connect G/V/S to a 3.3V port. Each sensor is sampled at most once per 2 seconds. Temperature failure=-127, humidity=-1.
scienceWater.temperature: a-003/004 DS18B20: use a 3.3V digital port with module pull-up. Up to three probes on one pin, ordered by ROM search, not socket position. Failure=-127 °C.
scienceDisplay.lcdLine: dis-001: connect LCD1602 to the shield's suitable I2C supply port. Address 0x20/0x27/0x3F is found automatically. English/numbers, 16 characters per line.
scienceDisplay.lcdClear: Erase both lines of the automatically detected I2C LCD1602.
scienceDisplay.setOLED: Default SSD1306 matches both OLED sizes in the order list. Select SH1106 only when the module controller is confirmed; size alone does not identify the chip.
scienceDisplay.oledLine: dis-011/012: 128x64 I2C OLED. Line 1..8, up to 21 English letters/numbers. Initializes automatically.
scienceDisplay.pixels: dis-013/014 WS2812 RGB: use the pin printed at the selected shield socket. Brightness capped at 32/255. V2 hardware DMA; BLE coexistence still needs physical testing.
scienceAir.sgp30: i2c-004: connect SGP30 to I2C. It samples once per second in the background. First 15+ seconds and errors=-1. eCO2 is an estimate, not direct CO2 measurement.
scienceAir.ccs811: CCS811 I2C air quality, address 0x5A/0x5B. Keep nWAKE LOW. First 20 minutes/errors=-1; eCO2 is an estimate. First-use burn-in is additional.
scienceBio.pulseRaw|block: heart rate sensor $channel pulse raw value
scienceBio.pulseRaw: MAX30105 I2C optical pulse waveform; compatible with MAX30102 red/IR mode. Raw 18-bit counts, read every 20..100ms. Not heart rate or SpO2. Missing/stale data or FIFO overflow=-1.
scienceAir.startPMS: PMS3003/7003, factory active mode, 9600 baud. Sensor TX to micro:bit RX; RX to TX. Needs 5V power and 3.3V UART logic. Reserves UARTE1; USB stays available.
scienceAir.particulate: Atmospheric PM mass concentration. Call start once. First 30 seconds, checksum errors, deselected sensor, or no fresh frame for 3 seconds=-1.
scienceMotion.startEncoder: EC11 A/B contacts with common GND, 3.3V pull-ups. Slow hand-turn experiments only; a full four-transition cycle counts once. Pin changes reset the count.
scienceMotion.encoderPosition: Signed EC11 quadrature cycles since start/zero. Direction reverses when A and B are swapped. Not a high-speed rotation counter. Invalid setup=-9999.
scienceMotion.zeroEncoder: Reset the EC11 count and incomplete cycle to zero.
scienceWeather.clock: DS1307 already set and running, address 0x68. Reads only; does not set the clock. Needs appropriate power/I2C level shifting. Do not share its address with MPU6050. Invalid/halted=-1.
scienceAir.startCO2: MH-Z19D 5.0±0.1V power, 3.3V UART. Sensor TX to RX, RX to TX. Selects this sensor instead of PMS on UARTE1. USB remains available.
scienceAir.co2: MH-Z19D measured CO2 ppm. First 60 seconds, not selected, bad checksum, response timeout or data older than 3 seconds=-1. Sensor's configured measurement range still applies.
scienceDetection.laserDistance: VL53L0X I2C distance in mm, address 0x29. Do not share the address with TCS34725. Timeout, invalid range status, or range over 2000mm=-1.
scienceDetection.gestureProximity: APDS9960 proximity raw 0..255, not centimetres. Uses background sampling; first sample, disconnected or stale=-1.
scienceDetection.gestureColor: APDS9960 color raw 0..65535. Uses the same background sampler as gesture/proximity. First sample, disconnected or stale=-1.
scienceDetection.gestureDirection: APDS9960 completed gesture: 0 none, 1 up, 2 down, 3 left, 4 right. Consumed once; expires after 1 second. Sensor orientation matters. Error=-1.
scienceElectric.setADCAddress: Optional external ADS1115 only: 5V supply and bidirectional I2C level shifter to micro:bit. Channels A0..A3 are on ADS1115, not shield labels. Address change clears calibration.
scienceElectric.calibrateVoltage|block: voltage sensor external ADC $channel calibrate at $voltage V
scienceElectric.calibrateVoltage: 25V DC divider module into external ADS1115. Apply a known positive reference <=25V; ADC signal must stay within 0..5V and ADC supply. Calibration clears on restart/address change.
scienceElectric.voltage: Calibrated DC voltage from the divider through external ADS1115. Never wire measured voltage directly to ADS1115 or micro:bit. Not calibrated/read error/outside 0..25V=-1.
scienceWater.calibrateTurbidity|block: turbidity sensor external ADC $channel calibrate clear water
scienceWater.calibrateTurbidity: AZDM01 module through optional external ADS1115 (5V supply and I2C level shifting). Put in clear water and shield ambient light. Store actual clear-water signal; clears on restart/address change.
scienceWater.turbidity: AZDM01 relative transmission: clear water=100%, lower values mean cloudier water. Not NTU. Read error, calibration missing, or over 120%=-1; ADC signal must remain within its supply.
